key_provisions_or_claims: Current standards and EU/Member State laws inadequately address physical and mental health risks of human-robot interaction, especially for smart cobots.
Proposes encoding occupational health and safety enforcement directly into smart cobots, leveraging quantum computing.
Raises concerns on robot legal personality, liability apportionment and algorithmic explainability.
Proposes a new binding EU OHS Regulation for the smart cobot age.
Discusses the draft AI Liability Directive's burden-of-proof easing for AI harm.
annotation.summary_en: Journal article assessing EU legal and standards gaps on occupational health and safety for smart collaborative robots (SmaCobs). It proposes encoding OHS enforcement into the robots themselves, using quantum computing, and a new binding EU OHS Regulation, while addressing legal personality, liability and explainability.
annotation.title_clean: Encoding the Enforcement of Safety Standards into Smart Robots to Harness Their Computing Sophistication and Collaborative Potential: A Legal Risk Assessment for European Union Policymakers
annotation.title_en: Encoding the Enforcement of Safety Standards into Smart Robots to Harness Their Computing Sophistication and Collaborative Potential: A Legal Risk Assessment for European Union Policymakers
